tools.name: get_model_comparison
tools.description: Experimental football outcome model trained on stored Sportmonks results. Returns a chronological holdout benchmark and comparisons with National expert groups on the same matches. Includes sample sizes, date windows, accuracy, Brier score and log loss. Paired rates stay unavailable below 50 published matches. Does not promise high confidence or future accuracy.

tools.name: get_match_prediction
tools.description: The TipMaster expert prediction for one football (soccer) match, found by team names ("Bayern vs Freiburg", one team name also works) or by id. Returns the most likely final score (mostLikelyScore, National only), the top 3 exact scores, and the home/draw/away split of three groups ranked by their own record: Top 20%, Top 25% and All players. Once played it carries the result. Shares are final once status is locked or played (a Classic match with status open still moves); the person asking has nothing to enter. Classic matches have no score (scoreRecorded false), only home/draw/away. A group with fewer than 20 players is withheld (reason). Other close matches are listed in alternatives.

tools.name: find_matches
tools.description: Football (soccer) matches with TipMaster expert predictions, filtered by team, competition (e.g. "Bundesliga", "Premier League", "LaLiga"), mode, status and kickoff window: upcoming (locked), live and finished (played) matches of the last 10 days. Each line has teams, kickoff, status, result, the most likely score and the home/draw/away call of the Top 20%, Top 25% and All players groups.

mode.description: national (exact scores, 15 countries) or classic (home/draw/away, 25 matches a week); omit for both.

status.description: open, locked (final predictions, not played yet), played or cancelled; omit for all.

tools.name: get_accuracy
tools.description: How often TipMaster players got football (soccer) matches right, per group (Top 20%, Top 25%, All players): majorityCorrect is the share of matches where the group’s most common home/draw/away call was right, outcomeCorrect the share of individual predictions with the right outcome, exactCorrect the share with the exact final score (National only). National covers the last 8 weeks, each week’s groups ranked on the 8 weeks before it; Classic covers this season, ranked by career record since 1997, and career gives each group’s average career points per match since 1997. A group’s rates appear once it has 50 matches with a published split (reason too_few_matches until then). Pass competition (National league name) or game (Classic) to narrow it.

mode.description: national (exact scores, 15 countries) or classic (home/draw/away, 25 matches a week); omit for both.

game.description: Classic game: btm = Bundesliga TipMaster, tmi = TipMaster International

tools.name: get_expert_picks
tools.description: The current TipMaster Classic round: 25 real football (soccer) matches per game (btm = Bundesliga TipMaster, tmi = TipMaster International), each with the expert cohort’s home/draw/away split and majority pick (expertPick), and the whole crowd’s split beside it. The expert cohort is the top quarter, by career points per match, of this round’s players with at least 100 career Classic matches, a record kept since 1997. Expert predictions are published once the round’s entries close (Friday 18:00 Europe/Berlin, releaseUtc); before that released is false, expertPick and expert are null and expertSample is 0. Shares need at least 20 players.

game.description: One Classic game; omit for both.

Pass an id for one match, or mode/status filters for a list. outcome is null while fewer than 20 players have predicted.
